Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by doing X" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this  effect require you to trash the specified number of face-down digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I trash just 1 face-down digivolution card for the conditions of this card's  effect?

Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?
